description: This Java source file contains an integration test class for testing the loan disbursement process to savings accounts with auto down payment functionality in the Apache Fineract project. It includes test methods that simulate loan creation, approval, disbursement, and verification of related transactions and events.

classes.name: LoanAccountDisbursementToSavingsWithAutoDownPaymentTest
classes.description: An integration test class for verifying loan disbursement to savings accounts with auto down payment in Apache Fineract. It extends BaseLoanIntegrationTest and includes setup, test execution, verification, and cleanup methods.

methods.name: loanDisbursementToSavingsWithAutoDownPaymentAndStandingInstructionsTest
methods.description: Main test method that simulates disbursing a loan to a savings account with auto down payment enabled, then verifies schedule, transactions, and events.

methods.name: verifySavingsTransactions
methods.description: Verifies the transactions on the savings account resulting from loan disbursement and down payment.

methods.name: mapLiabilityTransferFinancialActivity
methods.description: Sets up financial activity mapping related to liability transfer for the loan product.

methods.name: createLoanWithLinkedAccountAndStandingInstructions
methods.description: Creates a loan with linked savings account and standing instructions.

methods.name: createApproveActivateSavingsAccountDailyPosting
methods.description: Creates, approves, and activates a savings account with daily posting.

methods.name: createSavingsProductDailyPosting
methods.description: Creates a savings product with specified interest posting and calculation periods.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithMultiDisbursalAndRepaymentsWithEnableDownPayment
methods.description: Creates a loan product configured for multiple disbursals, multiple repayments, and enabled auto down payment.

methods.name: verifyTransactionIsAccountTransfer
methods.description: Verifies that a specific transaction in the loan's transaction list is an account transfer of a particular type on a given date.

methods.name: enableLoanBalanceChangedBusinessEvent
methods.description: Enables external event configuration for the LoanBalanceChangedBusinessEvent.

methods.name: disableLoanBalanceChangedBusinessEvent
methods.description: Disables external event configuration for the LoanBalanceChangedBusinessEvent.

methods.name: verifyBusinessEvent
methods.description: Verifies that a business event of type 'LoanBalanceChangedBusinessEvent' has been recorded with expected payload values.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up financial activity accounts after test execution.
